highlights.text: Designed and independently deployed multi-agent services on AWS ECS Fargate, with a gateway for routing, tenant-aware authentication, and multi-turn conversation state.

Built Python, Celery, and AWS Bedrock workflows for bill and invoice classification, structured extraction, and human review, with queue-based processing outside interactive API requests. Extracted **3,594 data rows** at a **20 s median per document** and cut a **12-document batch from 205 s to 42 s**. Estimated ingestion cost was **INR 0.44 per document** versus about **INR 310** in analyst time.
Built document retrieval and cross-company, year-over-year comparisons across reports from **1,000+ publicly listed companies**.
Cut API response time by **50%** through MongoDB aggregation and indexing. Used gevent worker pools for I/O-bound Celery work and Redis Pub/Sub to distribute real-time events.

Delivered tenant-aware access controls, Azure AD SSO, SSE streaming, and application email through AWS SES. Built a four-module assessment platform collecting data from **800+ partner organizations**.
